senses.gloss:
शौद्धोदनिः An epithet of
Buddha, son of शुद्धोदन.

शौद्र a. (द्री f.) [शूद्र-अण्]
Relating to a Śūdra or his tribe.
--द्रः
[]
The son of a man of any of the first
three castes by a Śūdra woman; see
Ms. 9. 160.

सौदायिक a. (की f.)
Whatever is given to a woman at her
marriage by her parents, or a
relative in general, which becomes
her own property.
--कं A nuptial
present so made.
